components.name: Button
components.blurb: All the native <button> props, plus variant, color, size, radius, hover and ready-made animations.
components.usage: Import from `vaiperui` and use it like a `<button>`: every native prop (`onClick`, `disabled`, `type`, `aria-*`…) keeps working. The look is controlled by the `variant`, `variantColor`, `size`, `radius`, `hover` and `animation` props.

import { Button } from "vaiperui";

  Click here
</Button>
<Button variant="outlined2" variantColor="danger">
  Delete
</Button>

components.name: Toast
components.blurb: Transient notifications fired from anywhere with toast(), rendered by a single Toaster.
components.usage: Mount `<Toaster />` once near the root, then call `toast({ ... })` (or `useToast()`) anywhere; it returns the id, and `toast.dismiss(id)` closes it. Toasts stack in a portal region, auto-close after `duration` (5000 ms) and pause while hovered or focused; `Esc` closes the focused one. `warning` and `danger` are announced assertively.

notes: `Toaster` renders a `<section>` with `aria-label` from `label` (default "Notifications") inside a portal on `document.body`.

The auto-close timer pauses while the pointer is over the toast, while focus is inside it, and while the tab is hidden; it resumes with the remaining time.

components.blurb: Accessible audio player with play/pause, seek bar, time, speed and volume.
components.usage: Wraps a native `<audio>` with custom controls. The seek bar and the volume use the library's `Slider`. Keyboard on the player: Space or K play/pause, arrows seek 5s and change the volume, M mutes. Every built-in text is overridable through `labels`. With `variant="waveform"` it becomes a compact voice-message card: the file is downloaded and decoded in memory to draw the bars from its loudness (pulsing meanwhile; a default pattern if it fails, e.g. no CORS on another origin), and the waveform is a slider (click or drag to seek, arrows move 5s). notes: The player is a `role="group"` named by `label`, so screen readers announce it as one control.
The play button changes its name between `labels.play` and `labels.pause`; the mute button between `labels.mute` and `labels.unmute`.
The seek bar and the volume are `Slider`s (`role="slider"`) named by `labels.seek` and `labels.volume`; the speed button announces the current rate (e.g. `Playback speed: 1.5x`).

With `variant="waveform"`, the waveform is a `role="slider"` with `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-valuenow` and an `aria-valuetext` like `0:12 of 0:40`; it is focusable only once the duration is known and `aria-disabled` before that.
The waveform bars are `aria-hidden`, so only the slider is announced.

While the waveform is being analyzed the bars pulse, and the pulse is turned off under `prefers-reduced-motion`; if the analysis fails (e.g. no CORS) a default pattern is drawn and the player keeps working.

guides.description: React component library styled with Tailwind CSS. Ready-made masks in the Input and a single color to customize any component.

sections.title: What it is
sections.body: Accessible, ready-to-use components. The `Input` formats phones, cards, dates and documents as you type, the `Select` is a combobox with search and keyboard navigation, and a single color paints the border, focus and icon on any of them.
